name: rickdiculousli-tools
description: Rick Li's personal, portable agent plugins.

plugins.name: hello-world
plugins.description: Example plugin with a greeting skill for verifying installation.

plugins.name: repository-info
plugins.description: Example plugin explaining the shared personal plugin repository layout.

plugins.name: visual-audit
plugins.description: Renders agent-written session reports into a visual HTML audit page.

plugins.name: quota
plugins.description: Read Claude and Codex subscription usage: windows, resets, weekly pace and projected unused quota.

plugins.name: yt-transcript
plugins.description: Fetch a YouTube video's timestamped transcript: captions first, then auto-captions, then Whisper.

plugins.name: method
plugins.description: Working-method skills copied verbatim from upstream: writing-plans (obra/superpowers). grill-me and grilling moved to the pocock plugin.

plugins.name: skill-shaper
plugins.description: Skill-shaper skill adapted from overment/skills: creates a new agent skill or reshapes one that triggers on the wrong requests.

plugins.name: pocock
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering and planning skills copied verbatim from upstream (mattpocock/skills): codebase-design, domain-modeling, grill-with-docs, grilling, grill-me, improve-codebase-architecture, retro and wayfinder.

plugins.name: pick-principles
plugins.description: pick-principles skill: at a phase change in nontrivial code work, picks and reads the few installed principles and skills that fit, applies them, and writes them into builder briefs.

plugins.name: recursive-refinement
plugins.description: recursive-refinement skill: a weekly pass per repo that lands small reversible refinements to the setup behind the user's jobs and writes the rest as specs, with a scheduler that keeps a weekly spend cap and a session-start surfacer.
